annotations.title: Things to do: what's in season, and who actually runs it

description: What there is to do on the East End: activities (surfing, kayaking, paddleboard, hiking, mountain biking, camping, horseback, climbing, shellfishing, birding, skydiving), on-water businesses (fishing charters, marinas, sailing schools and lessons for kids and adults from Optimist and Laser dinghies to ASA keelboat courses, yacht clubs, jet-ski rental) and wildlife to see (seals, whales, ospreys, sea turtles, sharks). Every result carries `inSeasonNow`, computed against the East End's calendar month, with the season window; `month` judges a different month. `noCommercialOperator: true` is the guide's checked finding that no business on the East End teaches or rents that activity (there is no kitesurfing school at Napeague and no climbing guide at Shadmoor). Where operators exist each carries phone, booking page, published price, source and date. Also returned: the permits an activity requires (shellfishing needs two), the conditions it needs, minimum-approach rules for wildlife, and skill and age limits. `seasonUnknown` counts records whose operator publishes only 'Summer-only' with no dates, quoted as published. A sailing school carries `sailing` (boats, small-boat or big-boat course, kids' ages, adults, certifications, members-only) and `sailing.guide`, the guide's page listing every school. With neither `query` nor `town` nothing is looked up and the answer lists the kinds and towns covered. Returns up to 8. `townScope` reports how the place argument was read; `townScope.recognized: false` means the name matched no East End place, the rows array is empty, and `didYouMean` lists near matches where any exist.

month.description: Month to judge the season for, e.g. 'October' or 'Oct'. Defaults to today's month on the East End.

query.description: The activity, e.g. 'kayak', 'fishing charter', 'surf lesson', 'seals', 'hiking', 'camping', 'whale watching', or an operator's name.

town.description: A hamlet ('Montauk', 'Sag Harbor') or a region ('the Hamptons', 'North Fork'), in the asker's own words.
